name: Royalty-free marketplaces (BlenderKit, Fab) - what you may not do
licence_summary: BlenderKit Royalty Free: commercial use without credit, but no resale or redistribution of the asset itself (including inside asset packs or game levels sold on marketplaces); BlenderKit also hosts CC0 assets. Fab Standard License: use in any engine or tool under Epic's terms; files are licensed to the claiming account.

licences.applies_to: Fab/Megascans (read the current licence on fab.com)

cautions: Never commit Royalty Free or Fab files to a public repository or a Baltor package; ship a manifest entry with redistribution: project-only.
Fab terms changed in 2024-2025; re-read the current Fab Standard License before each project.
